## Maven vs Gradle

**Maven** uses declarative `pom.xml`; **Gradle** uses a Groovy/Kotlin DSL and incremental builds. Both resolve transitive dependencies from repositories.

## Semantic versioning

Pin versions; use a BOM (bill of materials) to align a family of libraries (e.g. Spring). Watch for version conflicts (`dependency:tree`).

## Modules

The Java Platform Module System (`module-info.java`) enforces strong encapsulation; many apps still run on the classpath.
